title: File:Polarstern-shadow hg.jpg
desc:
During expedition ANT-XIX/2 in 2001 the German polar research vessel POLARSTERN is unloading container and goods to supply the overwintering station NEUMAYER in Antarctica. Snow mobiles are waiting to be served.
The image was taken from a tilted Polarstern helicopter during the late afternoon. Polar
